**Summary of Security Concern or Suggestion**
A clear and concise description of the security observation, dependency alert, or hardening enhancement.

**Affected Area**
- [ ] Native Swift Core (`src/native/main.swift`)
- [ ] Native Message Bridge (`bridge.js`)
- [ ] Frontend / Monaco Editor (`renderer.js` / `styles.css`)
- [ ] Dependencies & Supply Chain
- [ ] Other

**Details & Observations**
Detailed explanation of the risk, affected versions, or improvement opportunity.

**Proposed Solution or PR**
If you have a proposed fix or would like to submit a PR, describe it here.

*Note: For sensitive zero-day exploits requiring confidential pre-release coordination, you may also optionally use [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/imunishsoni/handbook/security/advisories/new) as described in our [Security Policy](../../SECURITY.md).*
